rubrics_metrics.description: Scrupulous accuracy in the text has been aimed at, but the eccentricities of spelling—which were the printer's, not the author's—have not been preserved, and the punctuation has occasionally been corrected.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek to use eighteenth-century diaries, letters, and contemporary newspapers to illuminate obscure passages and provide useful illustrations; avoid retaining annotations that are irrelevant or outdated.

rubrics_metrics.description: Portraits of Steele, Addison, and Swift have been taken from contemporary engravings in the British Museum; the imaginary portrait of Isaac Bickerstaff is from a rare picture drawn by Lens in 1710 as a frontispiece to collections of the original folio numbers.
